# Ceacio Alliance Limited

> Ceacio Alliance is an integrated operations support company delivering reliable, well-governed services across critical activities in the oil and gas sector. It supports oil and gas operations across Nigeria and West Africa.

Tagline: Building Capacity. Delivering Energy Solutions.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.ceacio.com/): overview, values, mission and vision, key figures, services, approach, why choose Ceacio, FAQ and contact form
- [About](https://www.ceacio.com/about): who we are, mission, vision, core values and approach
- [Services](https://www.ceacio.com/services): full service descriptions, sub-offerings, materials supplied, and HSE & ESG commitment

## Services

- [Mechanical & Electrical Maintenance](https://www.ceacio.com/services#mechanical-electrical-maintenance): planned and corrective maintenance of valves, pumps, separators and auxiliary equipment
- [Supply Of Tools & Materials](https://www.ceacio.com/services#supply-of-tools-materials): operational tools, worksite equipment and maintenance consumables, with procurement, delivery and site handover
- [Land Logistics & Haulage](https://www.ceacio.com/services#land-logistics-haulage): moving materials, equipment and consumables from source to site
- [Chemical Injection Management](https://www.ceacio.com/services#chemical-injection-management): injection coordination and monitoring against corrosion, scale and separation problems
- [Drilling & Exploration Chemicals And Fluids](https://www.ceacio.com/services#drilling-exploration-chemicals-and-fluids)
- [Lubricant & Diesel (AGO) Supply](https://www.ceacio.com/services#lubricant-diesel-ago-supply)
- [Kitchen, Housekeeping & Welfare Services](https://www.ceacio.com/services#kitchen-housekeeping-welfare-services)

Materials supplied: lubricants and other oils; pumps and parts; flow control equipment; turbine parts; oil and gas instrumentation; cooling and heating equipment; IT equipment and desktops; pipes and OCTG; other oil and gas equipment.

Other services: HVAC installation and maintenance; civil, electrical and mechanical works; facility maintenance; corrosion control; air compressor hire; pump maintenance; NCAA consultancy.
